However, briefly stated the allegations are that the Respondent No.2 got married with the Petitioner No.1 on 17th October, 2021.
Soon after the marriage, the ill treatment started.
The Petitioner No.1 was harassing her by telling her to bring Rs.50,00,000/- from her parents.
The FIR thereafter goes on to mention few instances that had taken place in November 2021.
There are allegations that the mother-in-law used to taunt her and the father-in-law used to look at her in objectionable manner.
There are allegations against the Petitioners for assaulting and ill treating the Respondent No.2.
Few instances of assault are mentioned in the FIR.
The charge-sheet contains statements of the Respondent No.2's parents and sister.
All of them have supported her allegations.
4) Now, the matter is completely settled between the parties and they had agreed to obtain divorce by mutual consent.
The Respondent No.2 has filed her affidavit which mentions this fact and the affidavit also mentions that she has no objection for quashing of the present proceedings.
The Respondent No.2 is present in the Court.
She is identified by her Counsel.
She reiterated the contents in the affidavit.
She submitted that she has no objection if the proceedings are quashed.
